description.en: Control network-connected Epson projectors over PJLink, with optional Web Control. Power, input/source selection, AV-mute, colour mode, Wake-on-LAN, plus model, serial, firmware, lamp/light-source hours and error-status sensors. Exposes a media player, a remote, source and colour-mode selects, and status sensors.

value.en: On the next screen, enter your Epson projector's IP address. PJLink must be enabled on the projector. Optionally provide a Web Control password (unlocks colour-mode control) and a MAC address (enables Wake-on-LAN power-on from standby).
